en.meta_description: Google Pixelsnap case made for the Pixel 10 Pro Fold in Obsidian: drop-tested, compatible with magnetic accessories, 52% recycled materials. Shipped to Korea.
en.headline: A Google Pixelsnap case made to fit the Pixel 10 Pro Fold, with drop-tested protection and magnetic accessory support
en.intro: This Google Pixelsnap case in Obsidian is designed specifically for the Pixel 10 Pro Fold, so it follows the phone's curves whether it is folded or unfolded. Our concierge checked the model, variant, stock and price before listing; after you order, FeelBetter buys it from the seller in the United States and ships it to Korea, typically in 7–14 business days.
highlights: Magnetic Pixelsnap technology lets you snap compatible chargers, grips and stands on and off with ease.
The shock-absorbent case has been drop-tested for hundreds of hours to defend against everyday "oops" moments.
It is made for the Pixel 10 Pro Fold, so it hugs every curve of the phone, folded or unfolded.
The listing says the precise fit keeps charging, audio clarity and signal strength unobstructed.
The case is made from 52% recycled materials and has a smooth, solid-color Obsidian finish.

sections.p: This case is made only for the Pixel 10 Pro Fold (model GA09846-WW). It measures about 6.29 x 3.05 x 0.36 inches (16 x 7.7 x 0.9 cm) and weighs 29.8 g (1.05 oz). Its design works with wireless charging and magnetic accessories.
The shock-absorbent build has been drop-tested for hundreds of hours, so it is meant to handle the knocks of daily use. The color is a plain Obsidian with a smooth finish.

cautions: Made only for the Google Pixel 10 Pro Fold; please do not order it for other phone models.
Magnetic chargers, grips and stands are not part of this listing, and the case is not water resistant.

ko.intro: Pixel 10 Pro Fold 전용으로 만든 Google Pixelsnap 케이스(옵시디언)라서, 폰을 접어도 펼쳐도 곡선에 딱 맞게 감싸 줘요. 컨시어지가 모델과 옵션, 재고, 가격을 확인해 올렸고, 주문하시면 FeelBetter가 미국 판매처에서 구매해 한국으로 보내드려요(보통 영업일 7~14일).
highlights: Pixelsnap 마그네틱 기술로 호환되는 충전기, 그립, 스탠드를 간편하게 붙였다 뗄 수 있어요.
충격을 흡수하는 케이스로, 수백 시간 낙하 테스트를 거쳐 일상 속 '앗' 하는 순간에 대비해요.
Pixel 10 Pro Fold 전용 설계라 접었을 때도 펼쳤을 때도 모든 곡선에 딱 맞아요.
판매 페이지에 따르면 정확한 핏 덕분에 무선 충전, 통화 음질, 신호 세기를 방해하지 않아요.
52% 재활용 소재로 만들었고, 표면은 매끈한 단색 옵시디언 마감이에요.

sections.p: Pixel 10 Pro Fold(모델번호 GA09846-WW) 전용 케이스예요. 크기는 약 16 x 7.7 x 0.9cm, 무게는 29.8g이에요. 무선 충전과 마그네틱 액세서리를 쓸 수 있게 설계되었어요.
충격 흡수 구조로 수백 시간 낙하 테스트를 거쳐, 평소 쓰다가 부딪히는 상황에 대비해요. 색은 옵시디언 단색이고 표면은 매끈한 마감이에요.

cautions: Pixel 10 Pro Fold 전용이라 다른 기종에는 맞지 않아요.
마그네틱 충전기, 그립, 스탠드는 이 상품에 포함되지 않고, 케이스는 방수가 되지 않아요.

es.headline: Funda Google Pixelsnap hecha a medida del Pixel 10 Pro Fold, con protección probada contra caídas
es.intro: Esta funda Google Pixelsnap en Obsidian está diseñada específicamente para el Pixel 10 Pro Fold, por lo que sigue las curvas del teléfono tanto plegado como desplegado. Nuestro concierge ha comprobado modelo, variante, existencias y precio antes de publicarla; tras su pedido, FeelBetter la compra al vendedor en Estados Unidos y la envía a Corea, normalmente en 7–14 días laborables.
highlights: La tecnología magnética Pixelsnap permite colocar y quitar fácilmente cargadores, agarres y soportes compatibles.
La funda absorbe los golpes y se ha probado contra caídas durante cientos de horas para los pequeños descuidos del día a día.
Está diseñada para el Pixel 10 Pro Fold y se adapta a cada curva del teléfono, plegado o desplegado.
Según el anuncio, el ajuste preciso no interfiere con la carga, la claridad del audio ni la intensidad de la señal.
Está fabricada con un 52 % de materiales reciclados y presenta un acabado liso en un solo color, Obsidian.

sections.p: Esta funda es solo para el Pixel 10 Pro Fold (modelo GA09846-WW). Mide unos 6,29 x 3,05 x 0,36 pulgadas (16 x 7,7 x 0,9 cm) y pesa 29,8 g. Su diseño es compatible con la carga inalámbrica y los accesorios magnéticos.
La estructura que absorbe los impactos se ha probado contra caídas durante cientos de horas, pensada para los golpes del uso diario. El color es un Obsidian liso con acabado suave.

cautions: Solo es compatible con el Google Pixel 10 Pro Fold; no sirve para otros modelos de teléfono.
Los cargadores, agarres y soportes magnéticos no forman parte de este anuncio, y la funda no es resistente al agua.

fr.intro: Cette coque Google Pixelsnap en Obsidian est conçue spécialement pour le Pixel 10 Pro Fold et épouse les courbes du téléphone, plié comme déplié. Notre concierge a vérifié le modèle, la variante, le stock et le prix avant la mise en ligne ; après votre commande, FeelBetter l'achète auprès du vendeur aux États-Unis et l'expédie en Corée, généralement en 7 à 14 jours ouvrés.

La coque absorbe les chocs et a été testée contre les chutes pendant des centaines d'heures pour les petits accidents du quotidien.
Elle est conçue pour le Pixel 10 Pro Fold et épouse chaque courbe du téléphone, plié ou déplié.

sections.p: Cette coque est uniquement destinée au Pixel 10 Pro Fold (modèle GA09846-WW). Elle mesure environ 6,29 x 3,05 x 0,36 pouces (16 x 7,7 x 0,9 cm) et pèse 29,8 g. Sa conception est compatible avec la charge sans fil et les accessoires magnétiques.
La structure qui absorbe les chocs a été testée contre les chutes pendant des centaines d'heures, pour les coups de l'usage quotidien. Le coloris est un Obsidian uni à la finition lisse.

cautions: Compatible uniquement avec le Google Pixel 10 Pro Fold ; elle ne convient pas aux autres modèles.
